text:
leo: Recap from Orion pilot sync — they asked for HIPAA-grade audit + automated PI redaction in the MVP. they said pilot contract is conditional and want the pilot two weeks earlier.

anika: HIPAA + redaction is a major scope bump. we're talking DLP rules, PII detection pipelines, KMS + BAA, plus legal review.

matt: Two pragmatic cutlist options to start the negotiation:
A) MVP-baseline: SSO + minimal event log (no PII captured/indexed). keeps current milestone.
B) MVP-hipaa: SSO + indexed audit + automated PI redaction (pattern-based + ML reviewer) + BAA workflow -> adds ~4 weeks and cross-team signoffs.

claire: Quick tech sketch (very high level):
```
MVP-hipaa-impact:
  infra: +1 index cluster (secure), +DLP worker pool, +regional-KMS
  security: KMS attestation + signed export paths
  compliance: BAA & DPA reviews (legal)
  cost: est +$12k/mo infra + onboarding ops
  eng: +4w (~1.5 FTE equivalent) for redaction pipeline + audit index
  risk: legal/BAA delay, false-positives in redaction, performance impact on latency
```

legal-bot: NOTE: executing a BAA and DPA amendments will typically add 10-15 business days. include that in any firm promise.

leo: Sales wants a single-paragraph customer blurb they can use in negotiation and a firm delta (time/cost) to put into the LOI. we can't promise BAA work inside a standard MVP window without LOI and cost coverage.

anika: Proposed commercial posture: offer a conditional MVP-hipaa deliverable — commit to the work if Orion signs LOI that covers 3 months of retention infra and agrees to a BAA timeline; otherwise ship MVP-baseline and deliver redaction as an early v1 within 6-8 weeks of LOI.

matt: If we pick the conditional route we should prepare a short trade catalog: what we will trade out of MVP to buy 4 weeks (e.g., internal admin polish, advanced telemetry, noncritical UX flows).

claire: Quick trade sketch: remove: admin bulk user import polish, experimental telemetry pipe, internal infra refactor. keeps customer-facing flows intact.

leo: Action items: @matt to post full A/B cutlist with line-item deltas (time/cost/risk) + a one-paragraph customer blurb by EOD. @leo to confirm exact LOI ask and sprint dates from Orion. reconvene tomorrow 10:00 PT to pick path. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Heads-up: auth-service canary scheduled 2025-10-12 03:00 UTC — coordinate feature flags and ensure redaction pipeline doesn't block canary if we go MVP-hipaa.
